The panel was asked a simple question:
Which cryptocurrency do you believe is undervalued?
Here were the responses:
Robin O’Connell (Uphold) — Bitcoin
Jason Allegrante (Fireblocks) — Bitcoin
Tyler Spalding (Acronym Foundation) — Bitcoin
“Man… I’m going to say stuff that will get me in trouble. So I would probably say Bitcoin — for the same reason — as much to my grin, being a payments person.”

The room suddenly looks… a little uncomfortable. ⚠️

I condensed this right down from 40 minutes. 
Enjoy 🌹
